description: Set the eBay connection's default shipping (fulfillment) policy for one eBay site, or null to remove it. Products without their own choice carry it in every new draft and when a draft goes live; LIVE listings keep the policy they have — change those with bulk_set_ebay_fulfillment_policy. The policy is checked against eBay's live list first; with no default, listings use the first policy eBay returns. Returns marketplaceId, previousFulfillmentPolicyId, fulfillmentPolicyId and the policy. Refused until the workspace owner switches on AI publishing. Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

fulfillmentPolicyId.description: A fulfillmentPolicyId from list_ebay_fulfillment_policies, for the same marketplace. null removes the default: listings without their own choice then use the first policy eBay returns.

marketplaceId.description: An eBay MARKETPLACE id such as EBAY_IT. Omit it when the eBay connection sells on one site.

name: set_ebay_default_fulfillment_policy
title: Set the default eBay shipping policy
